A person in a blue-and-yellow jacket stands directly ahead, within arm’s reach, facing the camera wearer and extending an open hand. Other participants are slightly farther behind on the narrow boardwalk; the nearest person partly occupies the wearer’s forward path. A collection bag and a small collected specimen are within reach, and the frames show the specimen being passed toward the person’s hand. The appropriate next action is therefore to complete the handoff so that person can explain the material to the group, supporting collaborative learning.
